facts.fact: RISA's PKI integration guidelines say RISA provides certificate validation and timestamping services, that RISA-GovCA provides the centralised timestamp authority, and that any system using digital signatures must follow them.

RWA.note: The document is technical PKI guidance and names no digital strategy.
The document names no electronic transactions or e-commerce law.
The document does not mention checking people against the national ID.
The document does not say who builds or runs government systems.
The document mentions no research institution.
